profileReadyRequires: editorial proposal reviewed by project maintainer
gates.runtimeRule: Only ready candidates may be promoted into personalities.json/personality-profiles.json.
gates.booksRule: A book is optional; missing books are backfilled from the next eligible ranked personality.
gates.profileProposalRule: Assistant may prepare evidence-backed editorial proposals, clearly marked proposed; only maintainer review promotes them to ready.

workflow.batchPolicy: Open research in validated geometric batches: 20 -> 40 -> 80 -> remaining pending. Double only after the previous batch process is reviewed and stable.
workflow.commitPolicy: Prefer one reviewed commit per complete batch; avoid per-personality and per-file commits.
workflow.reviewPolicy: Keep documented evidence separate from editorial 12-axis proposals. Human review is required before runtime promotion.
workflow.recoveryPolicy: Before reset/rebase/pull over local work, inspect git status and preserve unfinished work in a rescue branch/commit. Remote HEAD is the source of truth for committed state.
workflow.batchCheckpoint: 80-profile research batch opened after maintainer approval; 30 candidates remain pending. Research must still pass dossier gates before review.
workflow.metadataPolicy: PT/EN metadata may be drafted before profile approval. Drafted metadata remains outside runtime until portrait and profile gates are satisfied.
workflow.portraitPolicy: Portraits in review must exist locally as JPEGs and include source, license and attribution metadata in female-metadata-drafts.json. Human visual review promotes portraitStatus to ready.
